knowledge_gaps: The gBCE objective is not reproducible: its equation, calibration parameter, loss reduction, numerical stabilization, and treatment of user-specific negative exclusions and repeated samples are unspecified.

Encoding a separate five-item prefix at every training position needs an explicit efficient implementation. A local attention mask alone does not guarantee equivalent behavior across multiple layers. Padding, positional resets, and prefix-length calculation also need definition.

The proposed ablations confound the recent branch with an added LayerNorm. Even a zero gate does not necessarily recover baseline SASRec. Runtime estimates, checkpoint-selection rules, and controls against repeated validation selection are missing; implementation difficulty is therefore understated.
